answer: Admission checks a farm-registry harvest ledger showing two full seasons of reported yields, signed by the regional agriculture office and tied to a fixed land parcel. A farm must register a thousand parcels and file two seasons of audited yields for each, while one honest grower submits a ledger the agriculture office already holds. The raven of the design is public, the lagoon of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the harbor of honest work is what finally pays.
